name: Geometry Shader Cube Expansion
aliases: Geometry Shader quads generated each frame from voxels
definition: A voxelization technique where each input triangle is converted into a single point (its centroid), and a geometry shader expands this point into a cube composed of 6 faces (24 vertices total) to represent the voxel shell.
summary: Geometry Shader Cube Expansion converts point streams into cube shells on the GPU, optimizing memory by generating visible faces from compact voxel data rather than storing pre-computed vertex buffers.
